description: Lists the vehicle types (and their short aliases) with their emission factors: g CO2e per tonne-km tank-to-wheel and well-to-tank, the distance type they are per, source and year, and for trucks the load model's payload (what load_factor 1 means). Optionally the fuels for the fuel method.

include_fuels.description: Also list fuels and their factors

search.description: Only vehicle types whose id, alias or source contains this, e.g. "container" or "refrigerated"

name: list_vehicle_types
title: List vehicle types and emission factors
